benefits.definition: Osteoporosis is a condition characterized by weakened bones that are more prone to fractures. Also known as porous bone disease or brittle bone syndrome, it occurs when the body loses too much bone mass or fails to produce enough new bone. This condition is primarily caused by an imbalance between bone resorption and formation, often linked to aging, hormonal changes, and poor nutrition. Women, particularly postmenopausal women, are most commonly affected due to decreased estrogen levels. Ziziphus jujuba, or Chinese date, may help prevent osteoporosis by promoting bone density and supporting calcium absorption, thus reducing the risk of bone fractures in vulnerable populations.
